messages.author: 86b720a62f6c46f0
messages.subject: cpo$failure =1 in all locations
parts:
Hello,

I am quite new to INLA  and I am getting this cpo$failure =1 in all locations of my spatial model.

I am modelling 8 different years separately ( different models for each year), I have depth and habitat as covariates and when I run all the possible models for each year to do the model selection I find this problem in 3 of the 8 years. It always happens in the models where the spatial effect is in ( but not in all of them).

Do you think there is any connection? Any solutions? I tried changing the SPDE mesh sizes, increasing the precision of Kappa and Tau ( for the spatial effect) but it still occurs... INLA is starting to be too much of a black box to me.

Any tip of any kind will be really appreciated. Thank you very much in advance

iosu

messages.author: bbb9357156c132fe
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] cpo$failure =1 in all locations
parts:
I don't know enough about your model to comment on why this is
happening, but you can get all of the CPO scores by running
result.cpo= inla.cpo(result)

Best wishes,
Dan

messages.author: 86b720a62f6c46f0
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] cpo$failure =1 in all locations
parts:
Thanks to Dan and Havard I could overcome the problem. 

the problem is that the observational precision is estiamted to be to high and have to change the default precision of the hyperparameters by increasing the precision to:

control.family = list(hyper = list(prec = list(param = c(1,0.5)))

thanks again.
iosu
